item.title: Supreme Court grants anticipatory bail in Arms Act case; considers cross-case linked to civil land dispute
item.description: In the present case, the appellant is accused of assaulting the informant’s family and firing shots. The police recovered cartridges and bullets at the scene. The appellant submits that he has been falsely implicated. However, his anticipatory bail was rejected, leading to this petition. The post Supreme Court grants anticipatory bail in Arms Act case; considers cross-case linked to civil land dispute appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Public Prosecutor has no independent authority to seek police remand in absence of investigative agency’s request: J&K and Ladakh HC
item.description: “While the co-accused were acquitted on 19-8-2013, the absconders surrendered on 25-1-2014 and were subsequently formally charged.
